legacy_cells.B: Enhancing Safety in Diabetic Retinopathy Detection: Uncertainty-Aware Deep Learning Models with Rejection Capabilities
legacy_cells.C: Madhushan Ramalingam; Yaish Riaz; Priyanthi Rajamanoharan; Piyumi Dasanayaka
legacy_cells.I: 022_2025_Enhancing Safety in Diabetic Retinopathy Detection Uncertainty-Aware Deep Learning Models with Rejection Capabilities.pdf
legacy_cells.S: Whether a diabetic-retinopathy severity prediction on a retinal fundus image is sufficiently confident to accept, or should be rejected for human review.
legacy_cells.U: Human specialists / clinicians reviewing rejected predictions
legacy_cells.V: Accept the model prediction or defer the case for human review.
legacy_cells.AJ: DenseNet201 convolutional backbone with a Variational Bayesian Linear Layer (VBLL) replacing the final classification layer
legacy_cells.BV: Evidence lower bound (ELBO), comprising negative log-likelihood and a Kullback–Leibler divergence term for posterior regularization
legacy_cells.CR: Expected Calibration Error (ECE) = 0.0217 on the validation set
legacy_cells.EK: Rejection-threshold variation from 0.5 to 0.9; comparison of baseline DenseNet201 and VBLL-augmented model; simulated noise/blur robustness evaluation
legacy_cells.EM: VBLL uncertainty estimation with confidence-based rejection (70% threshold); rejected cases referred to a human clinician
legacy_cells.FM: Adds a Variational Bayesian Linear Layer to a diabetic-retinopathy classifier and evaluates uncertainty-based selective rejection and calibration.
legacy_cells.FN: At a 70% confidence threshold, accepted-sample accuracy was 89.93%, coverage 74.50%, rejection rate 25.50%, and ECE 0.0217.
legacy_cells.FP: Future work: apply the method to other medical-imaging tasks, evaluate more advanced uncertainty methods, use dynamic rejection thresholds, and involve domain experts in rejection decisions.
legacy_cells.FQ: The introduction identifies conventional DR classifiers' lack of predictive uncertainty and the risk of confident errors, motivating uncertainty estimation and rejection/referral.
legacy_cells.FR: The evidence is for static retinal-image classification, confidence calibration, and selective referral—not a persistent state, temporal transition, treatment-conditioned forecast, counterfactual, or planning result. Reported evaluation uses an internal validation split; no external, prospective, or clinical-workflow benefit evaluation is reported in the extracted paper.
legacy_cells.FS: Reviewer mapping: M7 Outcome & causal layer; M9 Safety & governance
legacy_cells.FT: Reviewer lesson: Use a calibration-aware rejection threshold and report accepted-case accuracy alongside coverage.
legacy_cells.FX: Complete extracted six-page PDF text, including title/abstract (p. 1), introduction and literature review (pp. 1–3), methodology and dataset/model details (pp. 3–4), results and Table I (pp. 4–5), discussion, conclusion, and stated future work (p. 5), and references (pp. 5–6). No separate limitations section appears; the text notes the accuracy/coverage trade-off. All pages were legible; no unreadable table encountered. | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text. This is a targeted audit, not an independent re-extraction of every negative/unreported field.
legacy_cells.FZ: A:I left untouched because the paper does not contradict the prefilled metadata. Included as component/supporting for its uncertainty-estimation/rejection contribution, not as a core world model. The PDF gives no dataset name, cohort size, sites, or explicit external/prospective evaluation. Methods contain a generic example of a CNN 'like ResNet or a custom small CNN'; the implementation details specifically identify DenseNet201, which is recorded. Evidence QA: 4/29 populated fields had a <=25-word quotation matching extracted PDF text (13.8%). Confidence is conservative; review this row where exact quote checks were incomplete. Codex audit: 29 prior populated fields have a located source quotation; 0 have quotations not located by normalized text matching. Unlocated quotations are review flags, not proof that the value is false. Companion evidence audit lists affected columns. Reviewer FS/FT/FU mappings are synthesis. Prior unsupported/missing fields remain Not reported; no clinical benefit inferred from offline simulation.

limitations: Unnamed public dataset/counts/sites/patient identities missing; validation results not independent external validation.
Generic ResNet/customCNN wording vs DenseNet201 implementation requires care; named implementation used.
70/15/15 stratified split lacks patient-level separation and augmentation/oversampling ordering.
ECE lacks binning/denominator/error bars/tolerance; no claim of valid calibrated clinical probabilities beyond measured ECE.
Noise/blurring and threshold-sweep/MI/Flipout claims lack reported detailed results; retained at claim/specification only.
Referral is simulated; no real clinician study/prospective use or patient benefit.
notes: Full6physical pages inclrefs5–6 read; TableI(p4),Figs1–2(p5) visually inspected. Component forM2/M9,not healthcareWM. Reported threshold wording includes above versus greater-than0.7; exact equality behavior not resolved.
